  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JANUARY 19, 2022

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Himmelrich at 5:54 p.m.,
  on Tuesday, January 19, 2022, via teleconference pursuant to Assembly Bill No. 361 signed by, Governor
  Gavin Newsome at https://primetime.bluejeans.com/a2m/live-event/ykjrkvyz .

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Sue Himmelrich
  Mayor Pro Tem Kristin McCowan
  Councilmember Phil Brock
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Lana Negrete (arrived at 6:00 p.m.)
  Councilmember Oscar de la Torre
  Councilmember Christine Parra

  Also Present:  City Manager David White
  Interim City Attorney Joseph Lawrence
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:54 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmember Negrete.

  CLOSED SESSIONS  There was no one present for public comment on closed sessions.

  Councilmember Negrete  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 5:55 p.m., to consider
  arrived at 6:00 p.m.  closed sessions and returned at 10:46 p.m., with all members present,
  except Councilmembers Negrete and de la Torre to report the following:

  Councilmembers Negrete and  1.A. Public Employee Appointment: Title - City Attorney
  de la Torre were excused at
  10:44 p.m.  The Mayor advised this matter was heard with no reportable action taken.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 10:47 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Sue Himmelrich
  City Clerk  Mayor

  1  January 19, 2022
